summary: Tested share feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass including POST /api/share (8-char URL-safe id, no _/-), GET /api/share/{id} returns diagram+views with increment on each call, 404 for invalid id, no Mongo _id leaked. Frontend: main editor still loads after BrowserRouter; empty-canvas Share shows 'Add at least one table' prompt (no API call); Share modal auto-creates share link; URL contains /share/; copy button works; ShareView renders 6 nodes/5 edges read-only for E-Commerce example; READ-ONLY badge present; view counter increments; dialect toggle regenerates SQL; SQL copy/download buttons work; ORM tab Django/Prisma/SQLAlchemy selectors work; 404 view renders for bogus share id with working 'Go to Editor'. One functional bug: Fork button navigates to / but diagram name does NOT show '(fork)' suffix because App.js useEffect overwrites the forked state from localStorage autosave.

integration_issues.issue: After clicking 'Fork to edit' in ShareView, navigate('/') mounts App.js whose useEffect calls loadFromAutosave() and overwrites the forked diagram set by loadDiagram(...) moments earlier. Result: user lands on editor with the previously-autosaved diagram (original E-Commerce Store), NOT the forked copy with '(fork)' suffix. Forked state is lost.

issues: React Flow warning (#002) about new nodeTypes/edgeTypes object being recreated on every render still appears on both routes. Minor — no functional impact. Already flagged in iteration_2.

action_items: Fix Fork flow: either (a) in ShareView.handleFork, write the forked diagram to autosave (persistence.saveToAutosave) BEFORE navigate('/') so App.js's useEffect loads the fork; or (b) in App.js useEffect, check a sessionStorage/location.state 'forkedDiagram' flag set by handleFork and skip autosave load; or (c) pass the forked diagram via navigate('/', { state: { diagram } }) and have App.js prefer location.state over autosave. Option (a) is simplest.

(Optional) Memoize nodeTypes/edgeTypes with useMemo or define at module-scope to silence React Flow warning #002 in both CanvasArea.jsx and ShareView.jsx (latter already defines at module-scope, yet warning fires — likely due to StrictMode double-mount).
critical_code_review_comments: ShareView.handleFork at /app/frontend/src/components/ShareView.jsx:88-99 calls loadDiagram then navigate('/') — race with App.js useEffect. Needs persistence or router state hand-off.

Backend /api/share uses secrets.token_urlsafe(6) then replaces _->a and -->b; this reduces entropy marginally and can cause collisions with existing IDs, but the 5-retry loop + 48-bit entropy makes practical collision probability negligible.
get_share increments views AFTER fetch and returns (views+1); this is correct but not atomic across concurrent reads — minor, acceptable for non-critical counter.

ShareModal uses nodes.length to detect empty, which is correct; handleCreate calls shareDiagram which POSTs the full diagram JSON — works. One minor UX nit: if user had ~100 tables, the auto-POST on modal mount gives no confirmation before uploading — acceptable per PRD.
No regressions observed in: example load, save modal, SQL/ORM tabs in main editor, AI tab, Ctrl+A select all, snap-to-grid toggle.
seed_data_creation: One TEST share snapshot created per run via POST /api/share (SAMPLE_DIAGRAM with users+orders). Also one share of E-Commerce example via UI. Shares collection accumulates docs; consider TTL index or cleanup cron in future.

ShareView testids: share-view, share-diagram-name, share-views, share-fork-btn, share-open-editor, share-canvas, share-dialect-mysql, share-dialect-postgresql, share-tab-sql, share-tab-orm, share-copy-sql, share-download-sql, share-orm-{django|prisma|sqlalchemy}, share-copy-orm, share-download-orm, share-loading, share-error-view, share-goto-editor. MongoDB 'shares' collection. To retest Fork fix: goto /share/{validId} → click share-fork-btn → assert at / with diagram-name containing '(fork)'.
rca_of_issue: Fork bug RCA: In ShareView.jsx handleFork() calls useDiagramStore.loadDiagram({...state.diagram, name: 'X (fork)'}) synchronously, then navigate('/'). BUT the user is on ShareView route — App component is NOT mounted yet. When navigate('/') runs, App mounts and its useEffect at App.js:26-33 runs loadFromAutosave() which returns the last persisted autosave (from before the share was even viewed). It then calls loadDiagram(saved) which OVERWRITES the forked diagram. Zustand store update from ShareView is wiped. Reproduction: load example → share → open shared link in SPA navigation → click 'Fork to edit' → observe diagram-name shows original (no '(fork)' suffix). Mitigation (simplest): in handleFork, call saveToAutosave(forkedDiagram) from /app/frontend/src/utils/persistence before navigate('/'). Then App.js's useEffect will hydrate from the updated autosave.
